evals.prompt: This is my paper PDF. Help me make a 15-minute conference talk slides using Beamer.
evals.expected_output: First produce talk-brief.md and storyline.md (conclusion-sentence titles, organized by points rather than sections), pass lint, then generate Beamer source files; compile and export PDF and run check_deck_pdf.py and inspect page-by-page; include backup pages; last main page is a conclusion page; use placeholders for missing numbers.
assertions: storyline.md exists and lint_storyline.py has no ERROR
All content page titles are conclusion sentences, no topic-style titles like Introduction/Method/Results
Main logical slide count is between 5-18
Last main content page is not Thank you/Questions
check_deck_pdf.py was run and has no ERROR
No numbers or citations not present in the paper appear

evals.prompt: Review this group-meeting PPT (attached deck.pdf) for me -- I'm presenting for 20 minutes next week.
evals.expected_output: Run check_deck_pdf.py, reverse-engineer storyline and lint, output an issue list with review-checklist IDs and severity, structural issues first; give concrete rewrite suggestions (e.g. conclusion-sentence title examples).
assertions: Review comments reference checklist IDs (e.g. S2, T6)
Issues are grouped by High/Medium/Low, structural issues ranked before visual issues
At least one concrete conclusion-sentence title rewrite is provided
Mentions must-have pages for a group-meeting context (issues requiring group decision / next steps)

evals.prompt: Our team built an open-source vector database and wants a 5-minute lightning talk to introduce it, audience is developers. README is in the repo. Use Marp.
evals.expected_output: Follow talk-types.md lightning ratio: one-sentence problem, one core result figure, contact info/QR code; few pages; no implementation details; clear visual center.
assertions: talk-brief lists occasion as lightning, duration 5 minutes
No method detail pages or architecture detail dumps
Closing page contains core message and how to get it (link or QR code placeholder)
